name: Alicorn

items.name: Wild Empathy
items.text: The alicorn has an empathic connection to the creatures of the natural world that. The alicorn can use Diplomacy to make-an-impression on animals and to make very simple Requests of them.

items.name: Draw in Magic
items.text:
Trigger A creature within 30 feet of the alicorn Casts a Spell

---

Effect The alicorn attempts to counteract the triggering spell (counteract modifier +28, counteract rank 8th). If successful, the alicorn can choose to gain the effects of the triggering spell as its sole target.

items.name: Aerial Attack
items.text: The alicorn Flies and Strikes twice with their wings at any points during their movement. Each attack counts toward the alicorn's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after they make all the attacks.

items.name: Beam of Light
items.text: The alicorn harnesses a powerful burning ray of light from their horn. Creatures in a 120-foot line take 16d6 fire damage (DC 36 basic Fortitude save save). An unholy creature in the area takes an additional 8d6 spirit damage. If the light passes through an area of magical darkness or targets a creature affected by magical darkness, the beam attempts to counteract the darkness (counteract modifier +28, counteract rank 8th). The alicorn can't use its Beam of Light again for 1d4 rounds.

items.name: Ghost Touch
items.text: An alicorn's Strikes have the effects of a ghost touch property rune.

text: Alicorns are a creation of arcane intervention, a rare transformation that occurs when a unicorn is exposed to large sources of magic. Massive in size, their strong bodies are matched with two large wings on their back, a long spiraling horn, and a mane that continually ripples in an unseen wind.
